configuration.source_roots: composite Eval backend/frontend checkouts; unchanged by QA

notes: Initial populated-instance phase before refreshing its stale frontend. Only observed cases are included; unlisted cases are not exercised in this phase. Invalid-login preparation used the unchanged existing authentication case. Backend has local patches; frontend is the older ce4d853 development client. Inline S-handle markers were plain text, while the footer citation opened the correct PDF passage. This environment mismatch is not claimed as a defect in current clean main. A follow-up run will record the refreshed frontend separately.

definition.title: Visible login and session restore
steps: Open the app without a valid session; inspect Email, Password and Sign in labels.
Sign in with the documented local development account, then reload.
definition.expected: Accessible login appears; successful login opens the correct tenant; reload restores the session.

evidence.description: Accessible login accepted the documented Eval account; authenticated Eval workspace remained available after browser reload.

definition.title: Invalid login feedback
steps: Submit a known local test email with an intentionally wrong password once.
definition.expected: Sign-in is rejected with generic incorrect-credentials feedback and no product data.

evidence.description: Invalid password was rejected with Incorrect email or password. and no workspace content.

definition.title: Authentication, Tokens, and Sessions — systematic Chrome coverage
steps: Login, refresh, replay old token, logout.
Use normal Chrome with the populated Eval account. Record observed UI behavior and unexercised parts separately; do not claim backend-only guarantees from UI evidence.
definition.expected: Valid access works; invalid/revoked refresh tokens fail.

results.reason: Refresh-token replay and explicit revoked-token checks require controlled token-level probes beyond the current visible browser flow.

evidence.description: Wrong password rejected; valid Eval login and reload worked.

definition.title: Tenant Isolation and RLS — systematic Chrome coverage
steps: Access another tenant’s records through API and database.
Use normal Chrome with the populated Eval account. Record observed UI behavior and unexercised parts separately; do not claim backend-only guarantees from UI evidence.
definition.expected: API returns 404; database excludes foreign rows.

results.reason: No alternate tenant principal is available for browser cross-tenant probes; database RLS is not observable from the browser.
results.residual_risk: Foreign-tenant 404 behavior and database exclusion remain unverified.

evidence.description: The populated Eval instance contains one tenant/account; account menu and Admin list show only Eval / eval@lumen.test.

definition.title: Roles, Groups, and Grants — systematic Chrome coverage
steps: Use normal Chrome with the populated Eval account. Record observed UI behavior and unexercised parts separately; do not claim backend-only guarantees from UI evidence.
definition.expected: Authorized access succeeds; forbidden operations return 403.

results.reason: A single admin principal cannot demonstrate different-role 403 responses or membership/grant revocation. Existing access settings were not changed.
results.residual_risk: Role/grant enforcement remains unverified beyond authorized admin visibility.

evidence.description: Admin Members & roles displayed the Eval principal as Member/Admin; Groups displayed the managed All members group.

definition.title: Retrieval Permissions and Ranking — systematic Chrome coverage
steps: Search with different users and ranking signals.
Use normal Chrome with the populated Eval account. Record observed UI behavior and unexercised parts separately; do not claim backend-only guarantees from UI evidence.
definition.expected: Only permitted results appear; fusion order matches expectations.

results.reason: Different-user visibility and deterministic fusion ranking cannot be verified with the single available account and browser UI.
results.residual_risk: Cross-user permission filtering and exact ranking math remain unverified.

evidence.description: Key Enterprises returned 20 relevant passages from kc-341.pdf with permission indicators and a cited direct answer.

definition.title: Grounded Chat and Citations — systematic Chrome coverage
steps: Ask supported, unsupported, and restricted-source questions.
Use normal Chrome with the populated Eval account. Record observed UI behavior and unexercised parts separately; do not claim backend-only guarantees from UI evidence.
definition.expected: Valid citations appear; unsupported answers refuse; restricted sources stay hidden.

results.reason: Unsupported/restricted-source probes not yet completed; the old frontend rendered inline [S1] as plain text.
results.residual_risk: Do not infer current-frontend citation behavior or restricted-source enforcement from this composite runtime.

evidence.description: GPT-6 Luna answered the two balance-sheet figures correctly; footer citation opened kc-341.pdf with NET ASSETS 334,852 and 274,639.
